VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: Structural and numeric values only. World units are metres: 1 Three unit = 1000 mm. All mm-to-world conversion goes through VghLantern__AppUtils__UnitConverter.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Renderer.PreserveDrawingBufferNote: Required so SnapshotExporter can read the canvas for drawing sheet placement.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Renderer.ToneMappingNote: None | Linear | Reinhard | Cineon | ACESFilmic | AGX | Neutral. Neutral is the Khronos PBR neutral curve, built for product viewers: it rolls highlights off without the desaturation ACES applies, so a powder coat on screen still reads as its RAL swatch. Left at None an HDR lit scene clips every specular highlight and the mid tones read muddy.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Renderer.ToneMappingExposureNote: Overall brightness dial. Raise this together with Environment Intensity if dark finishes still read too heavy.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Renderer.OnDemandRenderingNote: The loop only draws when something invalidates it, so an idle 3D panel costs nothing.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Camera.MaxPolarAngleNote: Clamped just above the horizon so the model is never viewed from underneath.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Environment.HdriUrlNote: Shared with ValeVision3D MaxEngine - the same 1024p optimised autumn field skydome, so a lantern lit here reads the same as the same lantern in a ValeVision scene. The 4k original is 25 MB and far too heavy for a web viewport.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Environment.IntensityNote: Scene environment intensity. Raise to lift the whole model, lower to deepen it. This is the main control for how dark a dark powder coat reads.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Environment.UseAsBackgroundNote: The viewport keeps its flat studio backdrop. A photographic sky behind a whitecard review model reads as a render rather than a drawing, and it fights the 2D panel beside it.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Environment.AmbientDimNote: Image based lighting already supplies omnidirectional fill, so the ambient light is scaled down by this factor when the HDR loads. Without it the two stack and every surface washes flat.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Environment.KeyDimNote: The key light is kept at reduced strength rather than removed, because it is what gives the glazing bars their edge definition; the HDR alone lights evenly and reads soft.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config.VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Materials__Mi: MIGRATED. Every material property - the finish palette, glazing, builders upstand and skeleton line - now lives in 02__Src__AppModules/02__AppData/Na__PbrMaterials__Config.json so the 2D fills and the 3D surfaces are driven by one file. VghLantern__Env3d__MaterialLibrary__.mjs reads that config directly.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__MeshBuilders.SkeletonModeNote: 'lines' draws centrelines only and is the cheap fallback when a profile is missing; 'profileSweep' extrudes the real section.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__MeshBuilders.SweepMiterJointsNote: Mitred joints are a later refinement; butt joints read correctly at review scale.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__MeshBuilders.PlaceholderSectionNote: When a role has no profile assigned, sweep a plain rectangle of the fallback size so the member still reads as solid instead of vanishing.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__MeshBuilders.BuildBaseAsSolidNote: Extrudes the builders upstand and the base frame as solid prisms with the reveal cut through them, which is what they physically are. Set false to fall back to swept sections along the base rings, which reads as a wireframe box with open corners.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__MeshBuilders.GlazingInsetNote: Glass sits back from the bar face so the frame reads as frame rather than coplanar with the glass.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__MeshBuilders.MaxSweptMembersNote: Guard against a pathological bar count locking the browser; excess members fall back to lines.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__ComponentLoad.ScaleGlbFromMillimetresNote: GLBs exported by the SketchUp CAD object builder are authored in mm, so they need the standard mm-to-world scale on import.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Snapshot.SupersampleFactorNote: Rendered at this multiple then downscaled, so the 3D view on a printed sheet holds up next to true vector linework.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Snapshot.FramePaddingFactorNote: Camera fit padding used only for sheet snapshots. Deliberately below the live-view Camera.FitPaddingFactor because the bounding-sphere fit already over-provides margin for wide flat lanterns; raise it if a tall finial ever clips the frame.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__Snapshot.GroundPlaneNote: Sheet 3D viewports are mounted with ShowGroundPlane false by the Drawing Editor, so the grid is never built into them. The live 3D View and the editor panel keep the grid from the GroundPlane block below.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.EnabledNote: Master switch for the setting-out display mode: the datums and construction triangles the factory works to, drawn as coloured linework over or instead of the solid model.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.DisplayModeNote: 'solid3d' the finished model alone. 'both' the model ghosted with the setting out drawn over it, which is the mode that proves a datum governs the metal it is meant to govern. 'setOut' the setting out alone with nothing occluding it.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.ShowClassNote: Each CLASS of setting-out geometry can be switched off independently, so a reviewer chasing one datum can strip the view back to it.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.CheckToleranceNote: How far a value measured from solved vertices may differ from the scalar the solver reports before the check is called a failure. Also applied to degrees, so tighten it if angular agreement needs to be finer than half a degree.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.DepthTestNote: False draws every construction line through the model, so the whole setting-out cage reads at once including the far side. That is what makes it an inspection aid rather than a decoration. Set true to have the solid model occlude the lines.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.LinePatternsNote: Alternating ON and OFF lengths in real millimetres, always starting ON. Patterns are stamped into geometry as discrete segments rather than shaded, which is the only way to get a true dash-dot and avoids the vendored line material's unfinished dash handling entirely. Because the lengths are in model millimetres they scale with the lantern, exactly as drawn linework does.

Datum__Frame.Label: Top of Framework at Eaves Datum

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.LineStylesNote: Keyed by <Class>__<Family>, which is composed from the setting-out entity's own Class and Family fields. There is no mapping table between geometry and appearance - the naming scheme IS the mapping - so adding a datum family to VghLantern__Geometry__SettingOutModel and a style here is the whole of adding a line class. A key with no style draws in magenta so the omission is visible rather than silent.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.WidthPxNote: CSS pixels, zoom invariant. Deliberately not millimetres: setting out is an inspection aid read on screen, not linework issued at a scale. The 2D SVG environment takes the opposite decision for the opposite reason.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__SetOut.SetOutNote: Setting out is built on every render alongside the solid model and is never captured into a snapshot - a sheet drawing shows the manufactured article, not the geometry that derived it.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.EnabledNote: Master switch for hover and pin model inspection. Off means no pick tables are written at build time, so the feature costs nothing at all rather than being hidden.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.PickCategoryNote: Each pickable class can be switched off independently. A disabled class is not registered, so the cursor sees straight through it to whatever sits behind.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.ClickMoveToleranceNote: A press that travels further than this before release is an orbit drag, not a click, and never pins. Raise it for touch screens where a tap wanders.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.LinePickToleranceNote: Pick radius around a centreline in the 'lines' skeleton mode only. Stated in millimetres because Three's own default is one world unit, which in this metre-scale scene would be a one metre pick radius.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.ShowHintRowNote: Adds the 'Click to pin' / 'Click again or press Escape to release' line at the foot of the panel.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.GhostOpacityNote: The ghost tier fades by colour rather than by transparency at the default of 1.0. This scene has no order-independent transparency, so genuinely translucent ghosting makes members behind members flicker as the camera turns. Drop this below 1 only if that trade is wanted.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.SiblingColourNote: Every other instance of the hovered role. Reads as a family without competing with the one instance under the cursor.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__HoverInspecto.InspectorNote: Presentation and behaviour for the hover inspector. The tier colours live here rather than in the Materials block so the whole feature is tuned from one place; MaterialLibrary reads them from here.

VghLantern__Env3d__Config__DedicatedView.ShowDisplayModeToggleNote: Adds the Display cluster to the 3D View overlay, switching between the solid model, the model with setting out over it, and the setting out alone. The editor's small 3D panel and the drawing sheet viewports never offer it.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__DedicatedView.ShowHoverInspectorNote: Whether the full-screen 3D View mode attaches the hover inspector. The editor's small 3D panel and the drawing sheet viewports deliberately do not, so a review surface behaves differently to a working one.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__DedicatedView.ShowSkeletonModeLabelNote: Read-only readout of the active MeshBuilders.SkeletonMode, so a reviewer can see whether they are looking at swept sections or bare centrelines.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__DedicatedView.DisposeOnModeExitNote: Keeping the context alive between visits costs one GL context but makes returning to the 3D View instant; set true on machines short of GPU memory.
VghLantern__Env3d__Config__DedicatedView.ModeNote: Settings for the full-screen 3D View nav mode. Kept in the Env3d config rather than a mode config of its own because every value here is a property of the 3D environment, and the mode is only a full-bleed host for it.
